visual_iteration: Review verdict: the previous model was Codex's self-described functional foundation art (a box grip, a box head, a flat cyan screen and a cone), so it was replaced rather than re-rendered. The new probe keeps its frame and sockets. The first back capture was framed off the edge of the view and was retaken from yaw 200 at zoom 1.15.
limits: Native production ModelViewer, IconRenderer and CatalogItemIcons in an isolated review project with this worktree's compiled game code; the slots are diagnostic, not live gameplay inventory.

The held presentation (held-presentations.json) is unchanged and the model keeps the old frame: grip at the origin (socket_grip_r), length up Godot +Y, screen toward Godot +Z, the point at 0.275 m (socket_wire_tip, its contact socket). The first- and third-person views were not captured in the game for this change.
The reel widens the tool to 0.073 m on its right side (the old head reached 0.055 m).
The full test suite was not rerun for this asset-only change.
